newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks mixed in quiet London trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks mixed in quiet London trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were mixed in quiet trading in London on Monday, overshadowed by fears of rising U.S. interest rates that sent Wall Street lower again after Friday's 148-point tumble on the Dow.
"There was just a complete lack of interest throughout the entire market," said one dealer.

"People are concerned about the U.S. interest rate outlook and the volume in Hong Kong shares here has been declining. Institutions are overweight Hong Kong, they can't think of anywhere else to move their cash and they are just sitting on their hands."
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was down 8.91 points or 0.07 percent at 12,287.06, after the Hang Seng in the territory dropped 220.63 points to 12,295.97.
